topics.title_zh: 黄仁勋承认与间谍关联，英伟达陷入史上罕见经营危机
topics.title_en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Admits Affair with Alleged Spy, Sparking Board Crisis
topics.summary_zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋正式承认与一名被指控为中国情报人员的女性存在私人关系，英伟达董事会已启动调查，核查公司机密是否外泄。鉴于黄仁勋在AI算力垄断中的核心地位及美中科技博弈背景，此丑闻被视为美企史上罕见的国家安全与企业治理危机。
topics.summary_en: Jensen Huang admitted to an affair with a suspected Chinese intelligence asset, triggering an independent board probe into potential leaks. Given his centrality to Nvidia's AI dominance and ongoing US-China tech tensions, the scandal poses a rare corporate and national security crisis that threatens the stability of the global AI supply chain.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 现状维持派 / 投资人
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 部分英伟达投资者与政治盟友（如特朗普）
perspective_pro.speaker_en: Nvidia shareholders and political allies (e.g., Trump)
perspective_pro.point_zh: 黄仁勋的战略远见与对供应链的掌控无可替代，只要核心技术防线未破，个人私生活不应成为中断英伟达全球扩张的阻碍。
perspective_pro.point_en: Huang's strategic vision and supply chain control are irreplaceable. Provided that technical security remains intact, personal life should not disrupt Nvidia's global expansion.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业理性派 / 合规专家
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 企业合规官与地缘战略分析师
perspective_con.speaker_en: Compliance officers and strategic risk analysts
perspective_con.point_zh: 这不仅是道德危机，更是严重的安全漏洞。在美中算力战的关键窗口期，CEO个人被外国情报深度渗透，已构成无法承受的系统性风险。
perspective_con.point_en: This is a systemic security failure, not just a moral lapse. With high stakes in the AI compute war, a CEO compromised by foreign intelligence is an unacceptable liability.

linked_tweets.author: JayDsmart
linked_tweets.content_zh:
埃隆，这不是一键就能轻松完成的

付费用户正在实时观看 Grok Bot 的崩溃。即使使用最高的订阅计划，人们在限制重置之前几天就会耗尽使用量

与此同时，机器人每天都变得越来越慢、越来越不智能、越来越不可靠。过去工作完美的事情现在失败了，给出了错误的答案，或者陷入了困境

人们在正常甚至较轻的工作负载下达到 100% 使用率，使得该产品在一周结束之前几乎毫无用处。

您的团队几乎没有提及这些严重的使用和质量问题

Grok Bot 应该是一个可以处理实际工作的人工智能代理。但现在，它在那些相信你的承诺的人面前分崩离析

站起来。修复使用限制，恢复用户最初付费的品质
linked_tweets.content_en:
Elon this is not one-click-easy

Paying users are watching Grok Bot fall apart in real time. People are running out of usage days before their limits reset, even on the highest subscription plans

At the same time, the bots are becoming slower, less intelligent, and less reliable every day. Things that used to work perfectly now fail, give wrong answers, or get stuck

 People are hitting 100% usage with normal or even lighter workloads, making the product almost useless before the week is over.

Your team has said almost nothing about these serious usage and quality problems

Grok Bot is supposed to be an AI agent that can handle real work. But right now, it's falling apart in front of the very people who trusted your promises

Step up. Fix the usage limits and restore the quality users originally paid for

topics.title_zh: AI编码代理实测：74%的任务仍需人类收尾
topics.title_en: AI Coding Agents Reality Check: 74% of Tasks Still Require Human Intervention
topics.summary_zh: 阿里与多家高校的最新实测显示，顶级AI编码代理在处理复杂真实任务时，完全准确率仅为26.4%。与此同时，尽管人工智能导致失业焦虑蔓延，美国专业服务业却因AI咨询与法律需求激增，新增了7万个岗位。
topics.summary_en: A real-world test of top-tier AI coding agents shows a success rate of only 26.4%, with 74% of tasks requiring manual cleanup. Paradoxically, despite fears of AI-driven unemployment, the US professional services sector added 70,000 jobs in October, fueled by growing demand for AI consulting, legal, and accounting services.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 演进演变派 / 研发支持者
perspective_pro.point_zh: 26%的完全自动化率已是质的飞跃。随着MCP协议与代理协同能力的提升，AI正在将人类从繁琐编码转向高价值的系统设计工作。
perspective_pro.point_en: A 26% pass rate is a breakthrough. With advancing agent collaboration and MCP protocols, AI is liberating humans from boilerplate code into high-value system architecture.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 工业理性派 / 实效质疑者
perspective_con.point_zh: 在缺乏确定性的前提下，74%的返工意味着更高的测试成本与技术债务。过早盲目部署代理是企业在浪费人力资源而非真正提效。
perspective_con.point_en: A 74% rework rate introduces massive technical debt and verification overhead. Blind deployment of these agents wastes, rather than saves, engineering resources.

linked_news.title_zh: 尽管担心人工智能失业，但美国专业服务业 10 月份新增了 7 万个工作岗位，这是自 2022 年 7 月以来的最高水平，因为人工智能相关的咨询、法律和会计领域都在增长
linked_news.title_en: US professional services added 70K jobs in October, the most since July 2022, as AI-exposed consulting, legal, and accounting all grew despite AI job-loss fears (Ian Hodgson/Wall Street Journal)

linked_tweets.author: Effie Kavoura 🔶
linked_tweets.content_zh:
在添加另一个人工智能代理之前，我会问一个问题。

该代理将改进哪些业务决策？

不是它可以自动化多少任务。演示看起来并不那么令人印象深刻。

工作完成后，公司会发生什么变化？
linked_tweets.content_en:
Before adding another AI agent, I'd ask one question.

What business decision will this agent improve?

Not how many tasks it can automate. Not how impressive the demo looks.

What changes for the company when the work is done?

linked_tweets.author: Aravind Srinivas
linked_tweets.content_zh: 我自己也尝试过该类别的其他产品。队友高于一切。很高兴看到这引起了用户的共鸣。原因很简单：（1）利用（在代码中有效地运行代理跟踪），（2）模型中立（不会强迫你进入更糟糕的非前沿模型），（3）Perplexity 的搜索质量和准确性。
linked_tweets.content_en: I’ve tried the other products in this category myself. Teammates are a notch above everything else. Glad to see that resonate with users. Simple reasons: (1) Harness (efficiently running agent traces largely in code), (2) Model-Neutral (not forcing you into a worse non-frontier model), (3) Quality of Perplexity’s search and accuracy.

topics.title_zh: 美国AI安全中心（CAISSI）遭白宫干预，独立性存疑
topics.title_en: US AI Safety Center (CAISSI) Faces Independence Backlash Over White House Ties
topics.summary_zh: 商务部下属人工智能安全中心（CAISSI）的官员被曝须向白宫非正式汇报，这一流程引发了对AI监管独立性的深度担忧。与此同时，特朗普政府明确表示不愿在AI安全护栏上“让中国领先”，使得AI安全监管正日益政治化。
topics.summary_en: Reports reveal that officials at the Commerce Department's AI safety center (CAISSI) are being forced to report to the White House, fueling concerns over regulatory independence. Meanwhile, the Trump administration's stance—prioritizing national dominance over AI guardrails due to China's lack of constraints—is rapidly politicizing the AI safety discourse.

perspective_pro.role_zh: 🟢 国家战略派 / 护栏务实者
perspective_pro.speaker_zh: 白宫政策顾问与行政协调官
perspective_pro.point_zh: AI安全不仅是技术议题更是大国博弈。缺乏行政协同的监管只会让美国在技术迭代中落后，必须确保监管机构与最高决策层步调一致。
perspective_pro.point_en: AI safety is a national security imperative. Regulatory fragmentation risks lagging behind. Close coordination with the Executive branch is essential to win the global AI race.

perspective_con.role_zh: 🔴 机构理性派 / 中立学术者
perspective_con.speaker_zh: 公共政策分析师与学界独立研究员
perspective_con.speaker_en: Public policy analysts and academic researchers
perspective_con.point_zh: 监管若失去独立性，便沦为政治工具。当“安全审核”被作为政绩导向，任何技术评测结果都将失去公信力，导致极高的安全隐患。
perspective_con.point_en: When regulators lose independence, they become political tools. Once 'safety audits' become performative, credibility evaporates, leading to catastrophic technical oversights.

linked_news.title_zh: 在谈到人工智能安全时，特朗普总统表示“我不介意护栏。但我不想让我们处于第二位”，“中国没有护栏”（哥伦比亚广播公司新闻）
linked_news.title_en: When talking about AI safety, President Trump says "I don't mind guardrails. But I don't wanna put us in a deep second position", and "China has no guardrails" (CBS News)

linked_news.title_zh: 资料来源：商务部人工智能安全中心 CAISSI 的官员被要求向白宫办公室非正式报告，引发独立性担忧
linked_news.title_en: Sources: officials at the Commerce Department's AI safety center CAISSI were asked to informally report to a White House office, raising independence concerns (Garance Burke/Associated Press)

linked_tweets.author: Flames
linked_tweets.content_zh:
告诉人工智能代理它不应该做什么与​​使其在技术上无法做到这一点是不同的。

当人工智能代理处理某人的资金时，这种差异很重要。

您可以告诉代理人避免某些资产、设置支出限额或在出现一定损失后停止交易。但如果它仍然拥有执行交易的广泛权限，那么这些指令就只能到此为止。

通过 MOTES (@meetmotes)，所有者可以设置授权并签署权限。在拟议的交易进行之前，智能账户会根据所有者批准的规则对其进行检查。

因此，代理仍然可以分析市场并制定策略，但它必须在这些限制内运作。它不能只是允许自己在批准的清单之外支出更多资金或交易资产。

我认为这是自主金融更好的基础。赋予代理人做出决策的能力是一回事。确保它仅具有所有者授予的权限也同样重要。
linked_tweets.content_en:
telling an AI agent what it shouldn't do is different from making it technically unable to do it.

when an AI agent is handling someone's money, that difference matters.

you can tell an agent to avoid certain assets, set a spending limit or stop trading after a certain loss. but if it still has broad permission to execute transactions, those instructions only go so far.

with MOTES (@meetmotes), the owner sets the mandate and signs the permissions. before a proposed transaction goes through, the smart account checks it against the rules the owner approved.

so the agent can still analyse the market and come up with strategies, but it has to work within those limits. it can't just give itself permission to spend more or trade assets outside the approved list.

i think this is a better foundation for autonomous finance. giving an agent the ability to make decisions is one thing. making sure it only has the authority the owner gave it is just as important.
